# dsh-profile-bridge — generated helper (Windows).
#
# Runs OUTSIDE the Harness process, because the app holds its profile directory while
# it runs: it stops the app, points <profiles>\<active> at the profile you chose, and
# then leaves it to you to open the app again. It deliberately does NOT restart the
# app (see the README: "why there is no automatic relaunch").
#
# Every value below is written by the plugin; do not edit by hand.

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$mode         = '__MODE__'          # 'link' | 'unlink'
$profilesRoot = '__PROFILES__'
$liveDir      = '__LIVE__'
$targetDir    = '__TARGET__'
$activeName   = '__ACTIVENAME__'
$appName      = '__APPNAME__'
$logPath      = '__LOG__'
$stamp        = '__STAMP__'
$skipAppStop  = __SKIPAPPSTOP__
$graceMs      = __GRACE__

function Write-Log([string] $message) {
  $line = '{0} {1}' -f (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'), $message
  try {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $logPath
    if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $logPath -Value $line -Encoding UTF8
  } catch { }
}

function Get-AppProcesses {
  @(Get-Process -Name $appName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
}

function Stop-App {
  if ($skipAppStop) { Write-Log 'app stop skipped by request'; return }
  # The page needs a moment to receive the HTTP response before the app disappears.
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $graceMs
  $processes = Get-AppProcesses
  if ($processes.Count -eq 0) { Write-Log 'app not running'; return }
  $captured = $processes | Where-Object { $_.Path } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Path
  if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($captured)) { Write-Log "app executable: $captured" }
  Write-Log ('stopping {0} app process(es)' -f $processes.Count)
  $processes | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) {
    if ((Get-AppProcesses).Count -eq 0) { break }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
  }
  $left = (Get-AppProcesses).Count
  if ($left -gt 0) { Write-Log ('warning: {0} app process(es) still running' -f $left) }
  # The profile directory and the single-instance lock are released as the app exits;
  # give the OS a moment so the rename below cannot race a dying process.
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
}

function Remove-Link([string] $path) {
  # `rmdir` removes a junction or symlink itself and never touches its target.
  cmd /c rmdir "$path" | Out-Null
}

function New-Link([string] $path, [string] $target) {
  New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $path -Target $target -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
}

function Merge-Patch([string] $target) {
  $patch = Join-Path $target 'cordis.patch.yml'
  if (-not (Test-Path $patch)) { return }
  $text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $patch -Raw
  if ($text -match 'ui-settings-account') { Write-Log 'patch already carries desktop UI settings'; return }
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath $patch -Destination ("$patch.bak-$stamp") -Force
  $addition = "`r`n# Added by dsh-profile-bridge when the Desktop app took over this profile.`r`n- id: ui-chat`r`n  name: `"@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat`"`r`n  config:`r`n    transcriptView: standard`r`n    performanceUsage: detailed`r`n- id: ui-settings`r`n  name: `"@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`"`r`n  config:`r`n    enabled: true`r`n- id: ui-settings-account`r`n  name: `"@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account`"`r`n  config:`r`n    version: 1`r`n    step: done`r`n    usage: detailed`r`n    developerTools: true`r`n    purpose: null`r`n    process: standard`r`n    completion: api-key`r`n"
  [IO.File]::AppendAllText($patch, $addition, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
  Write-Log "merged desktop UI settings into $patch"
}

# The Harness Host runs with the profile directory as its working directory, so a
# helper that inherits it would hold a handle on the very directory it has to rename.
# Leave it before doing anything else.
try { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:TEMP } catch { try { Set-Location -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $logPath) } catch { } }

Write-Log ('start mode={0} live={1} target={2} cwd={3}' -f $mode, $liveDir, $targetDir, (Get-Location).Path)
$backupPath = Join-Path $profilesRoot ("{0}.fresh-{1}" -f $activeName, $stamp)

try {
  Stop-App

  $liveIsLink = $false
  if (Test-Path $liveDir) {
    $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $liveDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $liveIsLink = $null -ne $item -and $item.LinkType -in @('Junction', 'SymbolicLink')
  }

  if ($mode -eq 'link') {
    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $targetDir 'package.json'))) {
      # A junction to a missing target is unusable, so refuse before touching anything.
      throw "target profile has no package.json: $targetDir"
    }
    if ($liveIsLink) {
      Remove-Link $liveDir
      Write-Log 'removed the existing link'
    } else {
      $renamed = $false
      $lastError = ''
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) {
        try {
          Rename-Item -LiteralPath $liveDir -NewName (Split-Path $backupPath -Leaf) -ErrorAction Stop
          $renamed = $true
          break
        } catch {
          $lastError = $_.Exception.Message
          Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
        }
      }
      if (-not $renamed) {
        # Name whatever could still hold the directory, so a failure is diagnosable
        # instead of a bare "still locked".
        $holders = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
          Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine.Contains($liveDir) } |
          Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { '{0}({1})' -f $_.Name, $_.ProcessId })
        Write-Log ('rename blocked by: ' + $(if ($holders.Count -gt 0) { $holders -join ', ' } else { 'no process names this path' }))
        throw "cannot rename ${liveDir}: $lastError"
      }
      Write-Log "backed up the app profile to $(Split-Path $backupPath -Leaf)"
    }

    New-Link $liveDir $targetDir
    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $liveDir 'package.json'))) {
      # Roll back to the profile that worked a moment ago.
      Remove-Link $liveDir
      if (-not $liveIsLink) { Rename-Item -LiteralPath $backupPath -NewName $activeName }
      throw 'link verification failed'
    }
    Write-Log "linked $liveDir -> $targetDir"
    Merge-Patch $targetDir
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'unlink') {
    if (-not $liveIsLink) { throw "$liveDir is not a link; nothing to revert" }
    Remove-Link $liveDir
    $backup = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $profilesRoot -Directory -Filter ("{0}.fresh-*" -f $activeName) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
      Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($null -eq $backup) { throw 'no backup profile to restore' }
    Rename-Item -LiteralPath $backup.FullName -NewName $activeName
    Write-Log "restored $($backup.Name) -> $activeName"
  }
  else {
    throw "unknown mode: $mode"
  }

  Write-Log 'done'
  Write-Log 'the app stays closed on purpose - open it yourself to use the new profile'
}
catch {
  Write-Log ('ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
  Write-Log 'the app stays closed - open it yourself'
  exit 1
}
